redox_principle.oxidation: UEFI hides settings, strips capability, sells you half a machine
redox_principle.reduction: IFR extraction reduces the hidden to visible, setup_var.efi writes it back
redox_principle.rust: setup_var.efi is Rust. Redox IS Rust. The chemical and the code.
redox_principle.cycle: Each reboot is a redox cycle — oxidize (read), reduce (write), verify
